tasks.label: docker-start-pot-server-only
tasks.command: $env:IMAGE_TAG = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; docker-compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.development -p pot -f docker-compose-server-only.yml build; docker tag pot-server:$env:IMAGE_TAG pot-server:latest; $env:IMAGE_TAG = 'latest'; docker-compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.development -p pot -f docker-compose-server-only.yml up -d

tasks.label: docker-start-pot-client-server
tasks.command: $env:IMAGE_TAG = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; docker-compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.production -p pot -f docker-compose-client-server.yml build; docker tag pot-server:$env:IMAGE_TAG pot-server:latest; docker tag pot-client:$env:IMAGE_TAG pot-client:latest; $env:IMAGE_TAG = 'latest'; docker-compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.production -p pot -f docker-compose-client-server.yml up -d
